conclusions: Controller reserves incoming predecessor before staging; hard 128 records / 32 MiB caps include that reservation. Lazy metadata enumeration bounds work and refuses existing over-budget/unknown/reparse entries without pruning.

Before deleting any history record, every existing record passes private ACL, bounded byte, object-custody and filename/content hash admission. Each selected candidate is revalidated against its captured identity/length before file-only deletion. Current predecessor hash is excluded.

Batch pruning targets 64 records / 16 MiB and avoids full history rehash during ordinary checkpoint writes. Independent instrumentation observed 0 full entry reads ordinarily and 193 on 128-record batch admission/trim, retaining 64 including exact predecessor.

Actual 16 failed reconciliation attempts use maintained inert provider and real checkpoint writes; rollback preimages/custody remain exact. Large snapshots exercise byte-triggered trimming. Adversarial controls genuinely require a fresh unarchived predecessor before substituted-content/foreign-ACL pruning tests.

Installer applies the same hard record/byte bounds during immutable-history admission; actual Windows tests and independent 9-record 36 MiB legacy refusal pass. CI adds this inert fixture to existing portable suite; documentation describes caps, batch validation and manual oversized-store review.
baselineAssessment: Read-only source comparison: prior writer archived each distinct predecessor without retention bounds; no old staged code replay was performed.
limits: No deployed task/payload, real networking mutation, power-cut/directory-metadata durability or arbitrary privileged-writer CAS qualification. Root retains live deployment/readback ownership.
Mutex/trusted-private-path assumptions remain. Metadata/hash rechecks coordinate cooperating participants; this is not atomic exclusion against arbitrary administrators.
Existing over-budget stores deliberately refuse writes/upgrades pending explicit custody review; this review authorizes no arbitrary legacy pruning or recovery-archive deletion.
The earlier automatically rejected old-script staged replay was not retried or routed through another agent; baseline growth assessment is source-only.
Accepted-main SSH stdio CI additions present in the bound workflow remain covered by their separate review, not reapproved as part of retention.
